request.query: linear map equals identity if it fixes every element

items.name: Function.forall_isFixedPt_iff
items.type: ∀ {α : Type u} {f : α → α}, (∀ (x : α), Function.IsFixedPt f x) ↔ f = id

items.name: LinearMap.id_apply
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {M : Type u_8} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_2 : Module R M] (x : M),
  LinearMap.id x = x

items.name: LinearMap.id'_apply
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {M : Type u_8} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_2 : Module R M] {σ : R →+* R}
  [inst_3 : RingHomId σ] (x : M), LinearMap.id' x = x
